title: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
hook_text: Microsoft is offering buyouts to 60,000 workers
script:
Microsoft just offered voluntary exit packages to sixty thousand employees.
Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella is shifting the company focus toward AI.
The buyout offers reached staff located across the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada.
This move signals a fundamental shift in the size of the Microsoft workforce.
The Verge detailed how internal changes are rolling out alongside Notepad updates.
Would you accept a buyout for your role?
